markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and MUSK agreement, but only 2 of 5 similar cases are invasive.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%; InSitu <1% | Very high, one class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / OOD pct 1.0 | Reliable input; atypical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Invasive | Discordant neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; largest concept contribution [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules count toward invasive in concept model [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low score; concept model counts absence toward invasive · Weak
- **Neoplastic nuclei fraction** (regions 0, 3, 10) · context · 54% of nuclei; higher than 90% of reference images · Measured
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Score below typical; not given as a reason [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to match classifier. Leans on TILs (Weak).

## Could be wrong if
- Only 2 of 5 most similar cases are Invasive; three are InSitu.
- Calibration was tested on 132 images (ECE 0.05, upper CI 0.18); >99% may overstate.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 7:** Confirm tumor cells infiltrate stroma rather than stay within ducts.
2. **Region 8:** Lowest invasive probability (57%); look for tubules or benign tissue.
3. **Region 10:** Look for ductal confinement; that concept is Weak (12/20).
